page.layout: One page of text, one column, full width. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Heading "EXERC. XVII." with subtitle, then one paragraph of text ending the page. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: [?]Iosophiæ nono. Materia (inquit) est potentia,
quia ad speciem progredi potest. Igitur
materia per se nullo potest corripi morbo.
Postremo quicquid per se nihil potest age-
re, id quoq; nullo morbo affici potest: quan-
doquidem morbus (omnium medicorum
consensu) affectus est, præter naturam pr-
imo, & per se actionem lædens, aut impedi-
ens. Sed materia per se quicquā agere ne-
quit. Est enim tantum recipiens potentia,
& patibile naturę principium, per quod pa-
titur, dolet, & morbo afficitur corpus. Igi-
tur partis similaris materia per se, & absq;
forma & temperamento nullis morbis la-
borare potest.
EXERC. XVII.
UTRUM INTEMPERIES SIT
F-
Ernelius intemperiem temperamenti
morbum esse nō minus absurdè, quàm
materiæ immoderationem, & formæ
corruptelam, ibidem statuit. Nam id nulli-
us morbi potest subiectum esse, quòd acci-
dens est. Sed temperamentum est accides:
quandoquidem in qualitatis genere consi-
stit. Igitur nullius morbi subiectum esse po

Word "consi-stit" at a line end is partly smudged; the first letters could be "confi-" and are uncertain. The initial "p" of "potest" in the first paragraph is damaged and was read from context. Catchword "test." and signature "F" are at the foot. A stray dash in the right margin near the middle of the page is not text and was left out.
